title: {Syn} MapReduce Split Big Data Into Two Verbs
content:
MapReduce organizes distributed computation around map and reduce phases. Map emits key-value pairs; reduce combines values with the same key.

The abstraction became influential because it hid much of the messy scheduling and fault tolerance needed to process large datasets across clusters.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
